# T-2: Capture upgrade execution evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Connect flow-managed upgrade execution to artifact writing without changing default user-facing upgrade behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Flow-managed upgrade writes upgrade-result.json and tests/.raw/upgrade.log.
- No-change execution writes result no_changes with exitCode 0.
- Failed execution writes result failed with non-zero exitCode and raw log.
- Normal `sdd-forge upgrade` stdout and `--dry-run` behavior remain compatible.

## Implementation Notes
Use an internal helper or flow automation path for evidence capture rather than a new user-facing CLI option. Existing user invocation must keep current behavior. Capture stdout/stderr from the actual upgrade execution path.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests with `// spec: R3 R7 R10` exercise no-change and failure evidence generation through the chosen flow-managed entry point.
